module_summary: AXI virtual FIFO: an encoder segments the input AXI stream, per-channel raw vFIFOs buffer segments in external memory via AXI masters, and a decoder reassembles the output stream, with CDC-synchronized config and status.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input AXI-stream payload packed into segments by the encoder.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output AXI-stream payload reassembled by the decoder.

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI master write data storing segments into external memory.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: AXI master read data returning buffered segments from memory.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input stream valid into the encoder.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Encoder backpressure to the input stream.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output stream valid from the decoder.

anchors.name: ch_input_data
anchors.why: Segmented encoder output feeding the per-channel virtual FIFOs.

anchors.name: ch_output_data
anchors.why: Segmented vFIFO output feeding the decoder.

anchors.name: m_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: AXI write address into the memory ring buffer.

anchors.name: cfg_enable_reg
anchors.why: Latched FIFO enable; freezes base/mask config while enabled, synced to channels.

anchors.name: cfg_fifo_base_addr_reg
anchors.why: Captured per-channel memory base address for the ring buffer.

anchors.name: sts_fifo_occupancy
anchors.why: Synchronized FIFO occupancy status output.

anchors.name: cfg_fifo_size_mask_reg
anchors.why: Captured ring-buffer size mask passed to channels.

anchors.name: cfg_enable
anchors.why: Enable request setting cfg_enable_reg.

anchors.name: cfg_reset_reg
anchors.why: Registered FIFO reset request synchronized into channel clocks.

anchors.name: axi_ch[*].ch_cfg_enable_sync_2_reg
anchors.why: Channel-clock synchronized enable driving vFIFO cfg_enable.

anchors.name: ch_input_watermark
anchors.why: Channel watermark throttling the encoder output.

anchors.name: ch_input_valid
anchors.why: Per-segment valid from encoder into vFIFO channels.

anchors.name: ch_output_valid
anchors.why: Per-segment valid from vFIFO channels into decoder.

anchors.name: ch_output_ctrl_data
anchors.why: Segment header/control data passed to the decoder.

anchors.name: ch_rst_req
anchors.why: Reset request OR-ed across channels to reset all vFIFOs together.

anchors.name: m_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write address valid from channel write engine.

anchors.name: sts_fifo_occupancy_sync_reg
anchors.why: Occupancy sampled into clk domain on sync counter wrap.

anchors.name: axi_ch[*].ch_sts_fifo_occupancy_reg
anchors.why: Channel occupancy held stable on toggle-flag handshake for CDC.

anchors.name: sts_sync_count_reg
anchors.why: Free-running counter pacing status sync flag toggles.

anchors.name: sts_hdr_parity_err_cnt_reg
anchors.why: Pulse-stretch counter extending header parity error for CDC.

anchors.name: sts_hdr_parity_err
anchors.why: Synchronized header parity error status.

anchors.name: sts_fifo_full
anchors.why: Synchronized FIFO full status (empty/reset/active similar).

anchors.name: s_axis_rst_out
anchors.why: Combined channel input reset indication to input side.

groups.name: Stream encoder
groups.description: Packs input AXI-stream frames into header-prefixed segments for the virtual FIFO.

groups.name: Virtual FIFO channels
groups.description: Per-channel DRAM ring buffers written and read through AXI masters.

groups.name: Stream decoder
groups.description: Parses segment headers and reassembles the output AXI stream.

groups.name: Configuration latch
groups.description: Captures base/mask while disabled, holds enable and reset requests.

groups.name: Status synchronizer
groups.description: CDC of occupancy, flags and parity error into the clk domain.
